summary: The substance is right and complete for its scope: the pack rule and policyOutcome placement, the five-capability registry with {relation, rung}, a 24-cell matrix with real corpus pins, named runner/workload/denominators that cure the THRESHOLDS-NOW defect, the honest prototype-baseline disposition under D-007 item 5, G13 into required-now with a strict result grammar, the opaque non-mutation SARIF fixture, and finite hostile coverage. Every checker replays identically. What blocks adoption is provenance, not design: the document supersedes four user-made owner rulings without naming them, and one sub-obligation deferral relies on a reviewed act that does not yet exist.

mustFix.title: Four adopted owner rulings are superseded by implication, not by name
mustFix.where: section 5 ('This is an explicit ruling on the previously reserved route'), section 6 ('This is an explicit D-367 ruling'), section 7 ('This explicitly supersedes the unenumerated within-class universal reading')
mustFix.defect: The document changes decisions the user adopted verbatim: D-314 item 24 and D-315 item 4 (G3-HOSTILE: 'supply no per-class totals'; witness floor stands) are replaced by the finite coverage definition; D-314 item 25 (G3-SARIF-RUNID: 'Keep FC-OUTFAIL.committed-run-preserved parked ... trigger it only after the governing RunId recipe is bound') is replaced by the opaque non-mutation fixture; D-315 item 5 (G21-SCHEMA: 'Choose neither route and author no bytes here') is replaced by the envelope-level OQ-G21-4 ruling. None is quoted or cited; D-314 and D-315 do not appear in the document. D-367 permits the pair to amend them, but D-368 clause 5 requires explicit supersession, and the same standard was applied to D-368 itself (MF2) and to the security unit.
mustFix.consequence: The integrated application act would carry silent supersession of user-made entries, the defect class the B1/B2 recommendations and D-368 MF2 expressly rejected; a later auditor reading D-314/D-315 finds them contradicted by an adopted contract that never names them.
mustFix.evidenceToResolve: Add a 'Superseded owner rulings' paragraph quoting each sentence with its heading and item number, stating what survives (the D-300 witness floor as the coverage baseline; the RunId recipe still unbound and the fixture proving non-mutation only; truncated-body and invalid-UTF-8 unconditional RF-2 from D-315), and extending reversibility to restore them.
